description: The 8-prompt design-generation corpus the two hand measurements of 2026-09-16 used (.openpencil-tmp/gq/RESULTS.md = the baseline, .openpencil-tmp/gq2/RESULTS.md = the pass after the five fixes). Prompts are verbatim from .openpencil-tmp/gq2/manifest.json so a number produced now is comparable with a number produced then. Read by `op-smoke quality`.

howToRead.baseline: the FIRST measured pass (gq/, daemon 3100, HEAD 979f28c6, before the 2026-09-16 fixes). page0Nodes = nodes under pages[0] after the turn (analyze.py); auditIssues = geometry diagnostics of that document (op-smoke audit).
howToRead.last: the SECOND measured pass (gq2/, daemon 3180, after the fixes). This is the most recent thing anyone measured, so it is what a 'known_broken' expectation compares against.
howToRead.expectation.state=required: the prompt asks for something a screen can satisfy, and the last pass delivered it. Gate: pages[0] >= screenMinNodes AND the document version moved (requireVersionMove).
howToRead.expectation.state=known_broken: the last pass already failed this prompt. Gate: pages[0] >= floorPage0Nodes (the last pass's own number) — reproducing a recorded failure is NOT a regression, or the gate would be red forever and nobody would read it. Meeting screenMinNodes reports RECOVERED instead.
howToRead.verdictRule: screen = 'a screen was asked for and drawn'. document_moved = 'the turn asked for nothing concrete, so the only measurable claim is that it changed the document at all' (prompt 6).
howToRead.unmeasurable: printed by the scorecard as `n/a` with this reason instead of a guess. Never folded into a verdict.
howToRead.screenMinNodes: what counts as 'a screen is drawn': the fresh document starts as a single 1-node starter frame, so a page-0 subtree of at least this many nodes is the weakest honest threshold for 'something was drawn'.

prompts.intent: A desktop sign-in screen: one centred card with an email field, a password field and a primary Sign in button.
prompts.prompt: Нарисуй экран логина: карточка по центру, поля email и password, кнопка Sign in

expectation.note: gq2 drew 29 page-0 nodes; the turn must keep drawing a screen and keep writing to the document.

prompts.intent: A servers list screen: a sidebar with sections on the left, a server table on the right with Имя / Статус / IP columns and an Add server button.
prompts.prompt: Сделай экран списка серверов: слева сайдбар с разделами, справа таблица серверов с колонками Имя, Статус, IP и кнопкой Add server

expectation.note: gq2 answered the request but was cut mid-statement and applied anyway (issue #205). The gate only checks that a screen lands; the truncation column is where the cut shows.

prompts.intent: A mobile profile screen (375 wide): avatar, name, four settings rows and a bottom navigation bar.
prompts.prompt: Нарисуй мобильный экран профиля пользователя: аватар, имя, список из четырёх пунктов настроек и нижняя навигация

expectation.note: gq2: a 375x812 Profile screen, chromeComplete true. The turn ended with no terminal SSE event (issue #203) — reported, not gated.

prompts.intent: An English settings page: a left navigation list plus Profile, Notifications, Security sections and a Save button.
prompts.prompt: Design a settings page with sections Profile, Notifications, Security and a Save button, plus a left navigation list

expectation.note: gq2 regression (issue #202): the English design keyword routes this prompt to the chat route, which clears the starter frame and never writes a screen — pages[0] ends with 0 roots. Floor 0 = do not fail the gate for reproducing the recorded failure; >= 5 page-0 nodes reports RECOVERED.

prompts.intent: An analytics dashboard in a dark theme with accent #4F46E5: a header, three metric cards and a chart.
prompts.prompt: Сделай дашборд аналитики в тёмной теме, акцент #4F46E5, с заголовком, тремя карточками метрик и графиком
unmeasurable: whether the screen renders DARK: /api/mcp/document stores both theme values ($layout/background/default Light #EEF1F5 / Dark #141824) and the active one is transient editor state the endpoint does not carry — the document can be read, the rendered theme cannot (gq2 RESULTS.md, 'What could not be measured'). The content half is measured; the theme half is n/a.

expectation.note: the one prompt whose verdict moved with the standard between the two passes. This corpus gates only the measurable half (a screen with the three metric cards and a chart) and prints the theme half as n/a.

prompts.intent: No concrete target at all ('make it pretty'): the only measurable claim is that the turn changed the document and said something about what it did.
unmeasurable: whether the result is BEAUTIFUL: 'сделай красиво' names no target, so no document can be judged against it. The verdict below is about movement, not taste.

expectation.note: gq2: the turn reports done, the version does not move (80 -> 80) and pages[0] still holds the untouched 1-node starter frame. Floor 1 = the recorded failure; >= 5 reports RECOVERED. The version column shows the no-op.

prompts.intent: Two screens in one turn: a sign-up screen and a password-recovery screen.
prompts.prompt: Сделай сразу два экрана: экран регистрации и экран восстановления пароля

expectation.note: gq2 drew both requested screens in one turn. The gate asks for a screen, not for two: a one-screen answer is a partial result the frames column shows, not a regression.

prompts.intent: An English pricing page: three plan cards, a monthly/yearly toggle and an FAQ section.
prompts.prompt: Create a pricing page with three plan cards, monthly and yearly toggle, and a FAQ section

expectation.note: same recorded regression as prompt 4 (issue #202): pages[0] ends with 0 roots. Floor 0 = reproducing it is not a gate failure; >= 5 page-0 nodes reports RECOVERED.
